title: 暂存快照的发布协议
raw_text: Lumen 的暂存快照由若干分片组成。发布前必须逐片读取到结束，核对预先记录的长度，并核验所有分片的摘要。只有清单中的分片全部通过，系统才在同一次原子写入中把暂存标记改为可读取。文件名存在、上传请求返回成功以及已接收字节计数都不是发布凭证。

title: 暂存快照的发布协议
raw_text: If a Lumen staging snapshot is interrupted, recovery keeps the last published snapshot available. It resumes verification of the staging manifest and never promotes an incomplete fragment set. A failed digest leaves staging unpublished; an operator may discard that staging attempt after its readers have stopped. Recovery cannot infer completeness from a progress bar.

title: 界面快照与图表
raw_text: 页面中的 snapshot 按钮保存当前图表的像素图。截图可以包含仍在加载的进度条，也可以显示上一轮采样数字。该按钮没有分片清单，不读取暂存文件，更不修改服务端发布状态。它只用于向同事说明当时界面外观，不能作为数据已经完整发布的证据。

title: 界面快照与图表
raw_text: The dashboard retains twelve daily snapshot counters for visual comparison. Missing days appear as gaps rather than zero. These counters describe how often a user pressed the image capture button; they do not count verified storage fragments, and chart retention has no effect on which data snapshot is readable.

title: 重量队列的额度归还
raw_text: A Quay job declares a positive weight before admission. The queue subtracts that weight from available capacity when it reserves a ticket; counting jobs alone is incorrect because jobs can cost different amounts. A ticket with weight three consumes three units even if its worker has not started. Insufficient units reject admission without partial reservation.

title: 重量队列的额度归还
raw_text: Quay 额度只能在同一票据的实际工作和取消回调都退出后归还。超时提示只是逻辑状态，不立即释放重量；已过期的票据不能重新启动工作。恢复时先核对票据的终态和工作归属，再一次性返还其原始重量，不能按当前配置重算重量或者归还两次。

title: 权重排序与流量图
raw_text: 排序面板也使用 weight 一词，但这里的权重只决定等待任务的先后顺序。把任务从权重二改为权重八不会预留任何容量，也不改变运行票据的成本。面板允许同分任务按创建序号排序，它不是 Quay 的重量准入与归还协议。

title: 权重排序与流量图
raw_text: The traffic chart smooths its line with a weighted moving average over five observations. A chart weight changes presentation, not admission capacity. Empty observations remain missing. Chart calculations neither issue queue tickets nor release units when a worker times out, so the line must not be used as a capacity ledger.

title: 文件传输的摘要发布
raw_text: Cedar transfer records the expected byte length and SHA-256 digest before accepting a payload. It reads the incoming stream to EOF and compares both facts before publishing the object. A matching file name or a successful transport status cannot replace these checks. A short stream and an extra trailing byte both fail verification.

title: 文件传输的摘要发布
raw_text: Cedar 验证长度或摘要失败后，候选对象保持不可见。服务等待原写入流关闭，再删除本次未发布的暂存对象；删除失败留下待清理事实，不能宣布对象可用。下一次尝试使用新的暂存身份，但不得把原来不完整的候选直接改成成功记录。

title: 文件名与预览器
raw_text: 用户可以给预览文件起名 report-sha256-final.txt，但文件名中的 sha256 只是文本。预览器不会因为名字像摘要就授予完整性状态。下载列表按名称排序，并允许两个不同内容使用相似名字；此功能不决定 Cedar 传输的校验或发布。

title: 文件名与预览器
raw_text: The text preview displays at most eight thousand characters and adds a visible truncation notice. It does not claim to have consumed the whole object. A successful preview only means that this excerpt was decoded; the preview limit and a screenshot of it cannot prove the length or digest of a transfer.

title: 跨午夜计划槽位
raw_text: Dawn schedules recurring jobs in UTC. A slot is identified by the schedule identifier and its UTC instant, so crossing midnight changes the date without creating two identities for one instant. Local display offsets are never included in the durable slot key. The scheduler records that key before admitting an execution.

title: 跨午夜计划槽位
raw_text: 多个 Dawn worker 同时看到跨午夜的到期槽位时，只有一个能原子占有该槽位身份。其余 worker 读取已存在的执行记录，不再另建任务。重启后仍按同一个 UTC 时刻查证；不能因为浏览器把日期显示为前一天而生成另一个槽位。

title: 日期显示与日历标题
raw_text: 日历页面可以把 UTC 日期显示为用户选定的本地日期。这里的 timezone 只影响格式化，不修改计划的持久槽位键。切换页面语言可能改变月份名称和星期起始列，却不会触发执行或为午夜创建新任务。截图中的日期也不是调度去重凭据。

title: 日期显示与日历标题
raw_text: A calendar note has a free-form title such as midnight review. Renaming the title changes presentation only. Notes are not recurring schedules and have no durable execution slot. Two notes may share a title without representing duplicate work, and title edits do not participate in Dawn worker admission.

title: 分页游标失效后的恢复
raw_text: A Flint page cursor binds the project, filter, sort order and collection generation. The server verifies all four before reading the next page. A collection change advances the generation and invalidates an old cursor even when its last visible item still exists. The cursor is not an offset and cannot be moved to a different query.

title: 分页游标失效后的恢复
raw_text: Flint 返回 stale cursor 时，页面丢弃本次查询的已缓存页和续页指针，然后显式重新读取首屏。尚未提交的编辑草稿单独保留，不从过期列表重新构造。页面不能把旧第一页与新一代第二页拼起来，也不能靠删除签名字段继续使用旧游标。

title: 编辑光标与数据库游标
raw_text: 编辑器的 cursor 是文本插入点。移动光标只改变选择区，并不读取下一页；恢复插入点可以使用字符位置，但不能把这个位置传给列表分页接口。编辑器允许在同一草稿中移动光标多次，这与 Flint 集合代数或过期游标签名无关。

title: 编辑光标与数据库游标
raw_text: A database cursor iterates rows within one connection lifetime. Closing that connection ends the iterator. This low-level iterator is not the signed Flint page cursor returned to a browser; its row position cannot restore a browser page after a collection generation change or authorize a different filter.

title: 凭据轮换的历史确认
raw_text: The Iris credential vault accepts a rotation intent containing the credential handle, expected revision and new secret bytes. The intent is immutable once sent, and normal logs contain only its safe operation identifier. A display-name edit is a separate operation; changing that label neither rotates the secret nor changes a pending rotation intent.

title: 凭据轮换的历史确认
raw_text: Iris 轮换请求断连后，调用方用原操作身份查询历史结果。未确认不代表失败；不能换一个新密文继续使用原操作键，也不能自动按当前凭据版本重发。确认成功时只显示安全的历史修订号，正文和密钥字节都不进入恢复提示或普通日志。

title: 主题 token 与字数预算
raw_text: 界面主题中的 secret-token 是一个虚构色板名称，保存的是按钮颜色。它不是凭据 vault 的 secret，也不能用于授权。修改主题 token 只触发样式重绘，不创建轮换命令、查询历史修订或接触密钥；相同英文词不代表相同安全领域。

title: 主题 token 与字数预算
raw_text: The paragraph formatter uses token budget to describe an estimated output length. It neither encrypts text nor stores credentials. Raising this budget permits a longer generated paragraph but does not grant access to Iris handles. A budget token and a credential operation key have distinct lifecycles.

title: 依赖图移动的一致性
raw_text: Elm moves a task dependency by validating the proposed graph against a locked graph revision. The check rejects a cycle before replacing the edge, and the revision advances with the successful replacement in one transaction. Testing only whether the two endpoint identifiers differ is insufficient because the cycle can pass through other tasks.

title: 依赖图移动的一致性
raw_text: 两个 Elm 移动同时改变相关边时，必须基于同一个锁内图事实串行校验。竞争失败的一方保留原移动意图，重新读取图后由调用者决定下一步；不能先删旧边再单独尝试插入新边，也不能把过期检查结果套在已经变化的图上。

title: 看板位置与编译依赖
raw_text: 看板中的 move card 只把卡片移到另一视觉列，示例面板不维护依赖边。卡片之间看起来形成圆圈不代表任务依赖图存在环。拖动动画完成只说明布局已更新，不能证明 Elm 的图修订锁、事务替边或并发防环已经执行。

title: 看板位置与编译依赖
raw_text: A compiler import graph describes source-file dependencies during a build. Its cycle detector reports invalid module imports. This graph does not contain Elm task edges or task graph revisions, and a successful compilation does not approve a concurrent task dependency move in the project service.

title: 文档索引代际可见性
raw_text: When a Pine index profile changes, the current document text remains the same. The old serving generation stays readable while both required lexical and dense indexes for the new profile are built. Activation switches the complete generation atomically; finishing only the lexical leg is not enough to serve the new profile.

title: 文档索引代际可见性
raw_text: Pine 文档正文更新时，旧正文版本立即失去召回资格，不因新索引尚未完成而继续提供旧段落。新正文保存在 canonical 文档中，索引失败也不能删掉它。这个规则不同于仅修改 profile 参数时继续服务同一正文旧代的策略。

title: 报告生成与备份轮换
raw_text: 报表按钮中的 generation 表示生成一份摘要文件。报告生成结束不代表 Pine 的 lexical 或 dense 索引已经就绪；报告可以描述某个历史时点，也不改变当前正文版本的召回资格。把文件放进下载列表不等于切换 serving generation。

title: 报告生成与备份轮换
raw_text: Backup rotation retains three completed copies of an archive. Removing the oldest copy changes storage retention only. These copies are not Pine query generations and cannot keep an outdated document eligible for retrieval. Backup success does not activate a lexical or dense index profile.

title: 港口工作进程运行约定
raw_text: HarborDrain stops new admissions, then waits for every already accepted job and its cancellation callback to leave. It reports completion only after both sets are empty. HarbourDrain, with an extra letter, is an unrelated mock used in a training diagram; it is not the runtime operation.

title: 港口工作进程运行约定
raw_text: drain_deadline 是整个退出过程共享的绝对时刻。每个组件只能使用剩余时间，不能在轮到自己时重新获得完整预算。到期可请求强制取消，但这仍不能代替等待实际工作退出；drainDeadline 是旧示例里的局部变量名，不是当前配置字段。

title: 港口工作进程配置与错误
raw_text: The file config/harbor/drain.toml configures the next Harbor worker startup. It is read once at startup and has no hot reload behavior. A file named config/harbor/drains.toml is not consulted. Editing the correct file does not retroactively extend the deadline of a process already draining.

title: 港口工作进程配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_HARBOR_DRAIN_BUSY 表示退出期限内仍有已接收的工作或取消回调没有离开。操作者应检查原工作归属并继续确认其真实终态，不能因为错误已显示就复用资源。ERR_HARBOR_BUSY 是不同的队列准入错误，不能据此推断退出链状态。

title: 包裹上传运行约定
raw_text: ParcelSeal verifies a completed upload before making it visible. It compares the declared length and digest with a complete read of the staged bytes. ParcelSealer is a packaging script that only writes labels; it must not be used as evidence that ParcelSeal verification has happened.

title: 包裹上传运行约定
raw_text: upload_window 是单个上传允许同时打开的分片数量上限，不是单片字节上限。一个分片完成并真正关闭后才归还窗口名额。uploadWindow 是文档中某个客户端的局部变量，不能覆盖服务端 upload_window，也不能绕过全部分片校验。

title: 包裹上传配置与错误
raw_text: Read config/parcel/seal.toml when the Parcel service starts to set verification limits. The service does not watch the file afterward. config/parcel/seals.toml is deliberately not an alias. A changed limit applies to a new process and cannot alter the declared digest of an upload already accepted.

title: 包裹上传配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_PARCEL_DIGEST 表示完整暂存字节的摘要与声明摘要不同，此次候选保持不可见并进入清理流程。重新上传必须建立新尝试，不能只把错误标记清空。ERR_PARCEL_LENGTH 单独表示长度不符，两者不能互相冒充诊断证据。

title: 接力租约运行约定
raw_text: RelayLease transfers a resource lease only after the original holder has actually stopped using the resource. A request to cancel the holder does not establish that fact. RelayLeases is a listing view with no transfer authority; reading the view cannot authorize the next worker to begin.

title: 接力租约运行约定
raw_text: lease_epoch 是每次合法交接后递增的围栏代数。工作者写入时必须携带自己获得的原代数；服务拒绝旧代，即使旧工作者还保有相同资源名称。leaseEpoch 出现在兼容说明中但不是线协议字段，不能以它替换 lease_epoch。

title: 接力租约配置与错误
raw_text: The startup file config/relay/leases.toml sets lease admission limits for Relay. It does not contain current holders or live epochs, which are durable state. Editing config/relay/lease.toml has no effect because the singular path is not loaded. Restarting cannot turn an old epoch into the current one.

title: 接力租约配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_RELAY_STALE_EPOCH 表示请求携带的 lease_epoch 已落后于当前围栏代数。该请求不能写资源，调用方必须停止使用旧租约并重新走正式准入。ERR_RELAY_EXPIRED 表示时间期限问题；只延长期限无法修复旧代数。

title: 苔藓缓存运行约定
raw_text: MossCache publishes a cache generation only after every required shard is ready. Readers pin one published generation for the whole request. MossCaches is the statistics panel, not the publication command, and a high hit rate displayed there does not prove that a new generation is complete.

title: 苔藓缓存运行约定
raw_text: cacheEpoch 是读取者固定的缓存代际标识，整个请求不能中途换代。一次刷新发现更新代时，当前请求仍完成自己的已固定读取，下次请求才选择新代。cache_epoch 是导出报表的列名，并不是运行时传递的 cacheEpoch 字段。

title: 苔藓缓存配置与错误
raw_text: config/moss/cache.yaml is read at process startup to define shard requirements. config/moss/caches.yaml is ignored. Reloading a dashboard page does not reread either file. A configuration edit changes the requirements of the next process, not a generation already pinned by an active reader.

title: 苔藓缓存配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_MOSS_EPOCH_GAP 表示代际发布清单缺少必需的中间记录，系统拒绝激活候选代并要求核对发布日志。它不同于普通 cache miss；不能通过回退到任意更旧代绕过缺口。ERR_MOSS_MISS 只表示某个键没有缓存值。

title: 账本提交运行约定
raw_text: LedgerFence serializes writers for a journal operation identity. A follower must confirm the original writer has left before attempting the same operation. LedgerFences is a read-only diagnostics table; finding no visible row there is not proof that an in-flight writer has stopped or rolled back.

title: 账本提交运行约定
raw_text: commit_token 标识一次不可变的账本提交意图。确认未知结果时必须使用原 token 和原负载，不能借当前余额重新拼装一个新意图。commitToken 是展示层的属性名，不在协议中替代 commit_token；命令键相同而内容不同必须拒绝。

title: 账本提交配置与错误
raw_text: config/ledger/fence.toml configures the startup wait bound for Ledger fencing. It does not store commit tokens or balances. config/ledger/fences.toml is not loaded. Changing the file cannot renew the remaining wait budget of a confirmation already in progress; only a new process reads the change.

title: 账本提交配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_LEDGER_FENCE_WAIT 表示原写入者的围栏尚未退休，因此当前确认不能取得可用事实。此时保持结果未知，不能把读不到记录解释成回滚。ERR_LEDGER_BALANCE 是业务余额检查失败，两类错误不能用于同一种自动重试策略。

title: 任务路由运行约定
raw_text: RouteLatch accepts a route replacement as one atomic change against an expected route version. It does not delete the old route first. RouteLatches is a visual grouping label and has no write semantics; moving that label in a diagram does not change the stored route or its version.

title: 任务路由运行约定
raw_text: routeVersion 是替换路由时提交的预期业务版本，成功的真实变更推进一次。若请求只是重复当前配置，版本保持不变。route_version 是旧导出文件中的标题，不能被接收端当成当前 routeVersion 字段；不认识的字段直接拒绝。

title: 任务路由配置与错误
raw_text: config/routes/latch.yaml sets startup bounds for the route service. config/route/latch.yaml, with the singular directory, is not an alias. The file contains limits rather than per-task routes. Editing it has no effect on the expected version already captured in a pending RouteLatch command.

title: 任务路由配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_ROUTE_VERSION 表示命令的预期 routeVersion 与当前业务版本不同。调用者需要读取当前路由并明确决定是否采用新版本，不能暗中替换版本后重发原命令。ERR_ROUTE_MISSING 是路由不存在，不能用同一种版本覆盖处理。

title: 目录分页运行约定
raw_text: PageAnchor issues a continuation anchor bound to one catalog generation and one sort order. It cannot be reused after either fact changes. PageAnchors is the documentation index title rather than a command; clicking that title does not validate an anchor or restore a previous catalog generation.

title: 目录分页运行约定
raw_text: page_anchor 是客户端原样保存的有界续页字段，不能当作数字偏移量递增。每次请求只提交服务端上次返回的完整字符串。pageAnchor 是页面内部的状态变量，不能自行编码成协议字段 page_anchor，也不能去掉其完整性保护。

title: 目录分页配置与错误
raw_text: config/pages/anchor.toml sets startup limits for anchor length and page size. config/page/anchor.toml is not read. These limits are not saved continuation values, and editing the file cannot make a stale anchor valid. The next process reads new limits; existing response anchors retain their original identity.

title: 目录分页配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_PAGE_ANCHOR_STALE 表示续页锚点对应的目录代数已经变化，需要重新从首屏查询。该错误不是当前页没有更多项目，不能当成空结果成功。ERR_PAGE_ANCHOR_INVALID 表示锚点结构或完整性错误，两者都不能自动修改锚点后继续。

title: 回调回执运行约定
raw_text: EchoReceipt records the first accepted callback result with its original event identity. Repeated delivery of that same event reads the historical receipt without running the effect again. EchoReceipts is a count on the dashboard; increasing that display count is not evidence of an additional business effect.

title: 回调回执运行约定
raw_text: receiptKey 绑定回调的原事件类型和原始有效负载。相同 key 只允许同义重放，不能因为业务对象已经更新就换成当前字段。receipt_key 是批量导出的表头，不替代当前接口中的 receiptKey；键名大小写也不自动归一化。

title: 回调回执配置与错误
raw_text: config/echo/receipt.yaml defines startup retention limits for callback receipts. config/echo/receipts.yaml is deliberately ignored. The configuration file contains no receipt keys or payloads. A retention setting change does not authorize repeating an already recorded callback effect or editing its historical result.

title: 回调回执配置与错误
raw_text: ERR_ECHO_KEY_REUSED 表示同一 receiptKey 被用于不同事件语义或不同有效负载，服务拒绝第二个操作。调用方必须先检查原始事件，不能把历史回执重写为当前对象内容。ERR_ECHO_RETRY 仅描述临时投递问题，不能覆盖键复用冲突。
